turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail: eady shipped, can it still be changed?Agent saidOnce an order has shipped, it generally can't be changed or have items added to it. Most changes—including adding items or updating the shipping address—need to be made before the order is processed and shipped.If you want to make changes for future orders, you can log in and manage your subscription here: Manage Subscriptions.If you have a specific situation with a shipped order, let me know and I can connect you with our Happy Team for more help!
